data.value: A database is a shared, integrated computer structure that houses a collection of non-redundant, related data. It contains two primary types of data: End-User Data, which consists of the raw facts of interest, and Metadata, which is data about data used to integrate and manage those raw facts.

data.name: RichTextBox2.Text
data.value:
The Relational Data Model is the most popular model used for data storage and processing efficiency. It organizes information based on the following structural concepts:
- Tables (Relations): The primary structures where data is stored and normalized. - Columns (Attributes): Vertical categories where each column contains data values from the exact same domain. - Rows (Tuples): Horizontal records where each row contains a unique set of atomic values.
